div.head: Ine 1
div.ab: Ærest we bebeodað, þæt Godes ðeowas heora ryhtregol on riht healden.
XLV. Ærest we bebeodað, þætte Godes ðeowas hiora ryhtregol on ryht healdan.
Inprimis precipimus, ut ministri Domini rectam discipline sancte regulam iuste custodiant.
{XLIV} Ærest we bebeodað þætte Godes ðeowas hiora ryhtregol on ryht healdan.
First we command that God’s servants hold their proper rule according to law.
In the first place, we command that the servants of God heed, and duly observe, their proper 'rule.'
First we enjoin that the servants of God rightly observe their proper rule,
Zuerst gebieten wir, dass Geistliche ihre Kanones richtig halten.
First we command that clergy keep their canons properly.
